correctness.rationale: Walsh characters diagonalize L_w with eigenvalues 2 sum_i w_i a_i. Independent exact integer enumeration of 2^6 subsets verified exactly twenty double fibers, no triples, six published difference masks {15,23,27,30,59,61}. A two-vertex PBH restriction requires v·delta=1 modulo2 for each mask; xor of five masks 15,23,30,59,61=0 contradicts odd count five. Set {0,e1,e2} separates every double fiber since each delta has at least one of first two bits set; singleton fibers never vanish. New superincreasing weights preserve all old collisions and prohibit new ones, yielding every dimension d>=6. Finite enumeration establishes exact six-dimensional base, mathematical separation proves arbitrary d.

evidence: First-six-weight polynomial (1+t)(1+t^3)(1+t^5)(1+t^7)(1+t^9)(1+t^20) has exactly twenty double sums and no triples; difference masks are 15,23,27,30,59,61.

The five masks 15 xor 23 xor 30 xor 59 xor 61 = 0 form an odd parity circuit, preventing any two vertex restrictions from separating every double eigenspace, while every collision mask has bit 1 or 2 nonzero so {0,e1,e2} succeeds.
